items.title: How Toyota Built BasisPilot – an AI Assisted SAP Operations Platform on AWS
items.summary: This blog was co-authored in close partnership with Toyota Motors North America SAP team: Manish Kumar, Anshuman Kowtha, and Ashish Patel. Introduction Toyota Motor North America (Toyota) runs BasisPilot, an AI-assisted SAP operations platform, on a large SAP landscape on AWS.
